title: agentpace turn gap
description: One wait on the human in a main Claude Code session: the time from the agent's last record to the next human-typed prompt, beside the agent turn before it. Local only: these records are never shared, never part of the dataset and never a run row.

session.description: HMAC of the session id under the local secret, the same pseudonym as a run's batch.

week.description: ISO week of the human prompt, in UTC.

gap_s.description: Seconds from the agent's last record to the next human-typed prompt. Elapsed time, not effort.

agent_turn_s.description: Seconds from the previous human prompt to the agent's last record before this gap, or 0 when the agent wrote nothing in between.
